name: mail_sync_state
title: Mail Sync Folders
description: Where the sync has got to in one folder of one account: the server's UIDVALIDITY for the folder and the highest UID already copied. A message is imported when its UID is above last_uid, whatever its flags, which is why mail already read in another program is still copied (the predecessor searched UNSEEN and missed it). last_uid moves only after the rows for those messages are written, so a pass that dies half way repeats a little work and loses none; the repeat is harmless because every row id is derived from the message, not from the attempt. When the server reports a different UIDVALIDITY every stored UID is meaningless, and the folder starts again from a recent window, relying on the same dedupe. Written only by system_mail_sync; the owner may read it.
